कार्यालय आदेश / Office Order

Mrs. Mitali Dave joined IIT Indore on August 14, 2023 as Junior Assistant vide Office Memorandum No. IITI/Admin/PNT-197/2023/560 dated August 29, 2023.

Upon the completion of the probation period as per IIT Indore Office Order No. IITI/Admin/PNT-197/2024/428 dated August 22, 2024, and receipt of a favorable report concerning the character and antecedent verification, she is confirmed in service as a Junior Assistant with effect from December 23, 2024.

This Office Memorandum is published in English and Hindi languages. Utmost care is taken to translate the OM from English to Hindi. However, in case of any discrepancy in interpretation, the English version shall prevail.




To
Mrs. Mitali Dave
Junior Assistant
Department of Chemical Engineering
IIT Indore

Convener, Department of Chemical Engineering
Office of Dean of Administration
